title: Establish the executable session foundation
goal: Implement validated task contracts, revisioned in-memory journal behavior, a small trusted session lifecycle, and an honest command-line entry point.
scope: Implement the domain values and acceptance contract defined by the foundation contract.
Implement atomic in-process Journal append and kernel open, read, and cancel behavior.
Expose help and version behavior without implying agent execution or persistence.
acceptance: The executable foundation contract's seven evidence categories are covered.
The workspace builds and its formatting, Clippy, and tests pass without fetching dependencies.
The documentation states the limits of the in-memory foundation.
evidence: 17 existing Rust tests across the workspace
context: The foundation has no persistent storage, provider execution, public MCP, or terminal UI.

history.note: Recorded the checked executable foundation from commit 87ba96b.
